issue: Variable ARCH is referenced (lines 90, 93) but never defined; set -u (line 17) aborts the script with 'ARCH: unbound variable' whenever the wgturn-cli build path is entered (wgturn-core source reachable + go on PATH). CI build-mac.yml does not export ARCH either. Currently latent because wgturn-core is inaccessible from CI runners, but any local Mac build with wgturn access crashes, and CI will break if the repo becomes public.
fix: Add ARCH="arm64" before the wgturn if-block (the publish target is osx-arm64), mirroring how build-linux.ps1 sets $env:GOARCH="amd64" for its wgturn cross-compile.
